title: Bombay High Court stays SPPU order slashing ILS Law College fees; calls for fresh proposal
description: The Bombay High Court on Monday stayed the April 30 order of Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) fixing Indian Law Society's (ILS) Law College's "other fees" at ₹4,340 for the academic year 2026-27, while directing the college to file a fresh fee proposal.A Division Bench of Justices RI Chagla and Farhan Dubash found that the College's 2024 proposal sought approval of other fees for the academic years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 only and that it had not submitted a proposal f
